cases.case: P3 evidence as the AS would issue it after the real approval
cases.what: displayed_content = the view the person signed; timestamp = signed_at

cases.case: P4 same, confirmation recorded at the server's receipt time (14 min after signed_at, as in case 13b), token issued after it
cases.what: the AS time differs from the person's signed_at; still after it; a token issued before the receipt would fail the draft's own check (see N15)

cases.case: N12 AS fabricates a confirmation the person never gave
cases.what: valid AS signature over a different text and a time with no signature of the person
binding_problems: the displayed content is not the view the person signed

cases.what: the AS signature no longer matches
binding_problems: the displayed content is not the view the person signed

cases.case: N14 AS signs another text than the one the person was shown
cases.what: valid AS signature; the view digest the person signed names the real view
binding_problems: the displayed content is not the view the person signed

cases.case: N15 confirmation after the token was issued
draft_problems: the confirmation is after the token was issued

cases.case: N16 confirmation before the person signed
cases.what: the AS records it five minutes before the signature
binding_problems: the AS records the confirmation before the person signed
